description_en: Adds a domain-level recording callback configuration
description_zh: 添加域名级别录制回调配置
name: AddLiveRecordNotifyConfig

parameters.help_en:
The callback URL for recording events and status callbacks.

The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55016.html
parameters.help_zh:
录制回调（包括录制事件和状态回调） URL地址。

必须以`http://`或者`https://`开头。更多详情，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55016.html
parameters.name: notify_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether recording task status callbacks are required. Valid values:

true: Required. If NeedStatusNotify is set to true, the response includes a recording status callback example.
false (default): Not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要录制任务状态回调。取值：

true：是。如果NeedStatusNotify（是否需要录制任务状态回调）选择为true，则返回结果为录制状态回调示例。
false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: need_status_notify

parameters.help_en:
The callback URL for on-demand recording.

The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85910.html
parameters.help_zh:
按需录制回调URL地址。

必须以`http://`或者`https://`开头。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85910.html
parameters.name: on_demand_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable callback authentication. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false (default): Disabled.

When this parameter is set to true, the NotifyAuthKey parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
回调鉴权开关。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认）：关闭。

当填true时NotifyAuthKey必填
parameters.name: notify_req_auth

parameters.help_en:
The callback authentication key. The key must be 16 to 32 characters in length and can contain only letters and digits.
This parameter is required when the NotifyReqAuth parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
回调鉴权密钥，长度为16~32个字符，只允许填大小写字母和数字。
当NotifyReqAuth参数值为true时该参数必填
parameters.name: notify_auth_key
